external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.
external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow

classes.content: User instructions; source file metadata and raw column names; at most the first 20 normalized preview rows per qualified source; mapping assumptions and decisions; aggregate match and exception counts; assurance gates, limitations, review notes and artifact paths; when a worker selection is reviewed, its model/effort, reviewer reference, review status and benchmark digest may be read in the parent runtime. The selection review is retained in local evidence and is not added to the subordinate worker prompt. Resolution-funnel and human-review aggregate values are partitioned by explicit currency and measurement unit. Mixed or unknown denominations withhold a scalar total and expose the qualification; no conversion is inferred.
classes.purpose: Map source columns before deterministic reconciliation and review run-level controls and limitations

classes.content: The model first receives aggregate item-type counts and an index of opaque per-run case handles, item type, normalized categorical review status, recommended action and only the names of present mechanical signal classes; signal values and source facts remain out. Accepted non-interpretive artifact items remain available to the human widget but are omitted. The model can then request at most 25 selected cases per call. Selected context contains only populated mapped fields such as side, dates, signed amounts, currency, description, beneficiary or counterparty, account name, entity, party, direction, deterministic match stage and deltas, and missing-evidence reason. Unmapped raw columns, empty fields, physical source locators, technical row IDs, review write targets, duplicate facts and the redundant absolute amount are omitted. Exact references, movement numbers, shared references and account codes are off by default and can be requested only for selected cases. Real names, descriptions and other accounting facts can remain; opaque handles are routing controls, not anonymization or pseudonymization of the professional case data. Producer-generated document requests can quote exact identifiers, so selected-case model projection also withholds requested_document unless include_exact_identifiers is true. This field gate applies in both data and evidence. The full human review remains unchanged. Mapped descriptions and other selected source text are not automatically anonymized.
classes.purpose: Select and interpret review cases without sending the complete ordinary review payload

classes.content: One bounded packet containing the complete admitted set of unresolved bank rows and hard-compatible journal candidates; populated canonical signed amount, date, description, beneficiary or counterparty, reference, movement number, account and perimeter fields selected after source-column mapping; and the reviewed matching policy. Unmapped raw columns, empty canonical fields, physical source locators and the redundant absolute amount are omitted. This separate Codex-only worker phase is unchanged by the ordinary review-index transport.
classes.purpose: Classify, identify, or suggest eligible relationships for unresolved bank movements, retaining semantic residuals for draft review by default or applying an explicitly established clearance policy

classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.
classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested

classes.content: Bounded PDF layout evidence: at most 300 words from each of the first two and final pages, capped at 100 characters per word, their x/top coordinates, page dimensions, source SHA-256, page count and truncation status. Layout coordinates and printed header/footer labels are reviewed by the host model; no column semantics are inferred from number clusters. A dry-run preview contains at most twenty reconstructed postings per source for reconciliation. Entire registration reconstruction and exact debit/credit closure run locally, preserving source page/row lineage. Case names and accounting text in the sampled words are not anonymized. The helper makes no direct model API calls or new external-service requests. During layout recovery, the model can request up to three pages or regions per inspection, with at most 300 words and 1,200 characters with coordinates per page, and images of requested regions. It also receives proposed recipes and trial diagnostics; the history stays in the case workspace. Distinct evidence-based trials and targeted inspections retain their complete history without a fixed lifetime count; each inspection keeps the same per-call page, word and character bounds. This data is not anonymized and this procedure does not send it to developers. Local negative-amount eligibility scans retain every unsupported notation or unreviewed sign location in the diagnostics. Recovery responses expose at most 50 issues with page, row, amount band, printed token, notation and reason; full retained diagnostics can be opened for a specific unresolved question. Recipes expose both reviewed negative notation and sign semantics. No additional model API call or external destination is introduced.
classes.purpose: Review the physical layout of a text-PDF accounting journal before local reconstruction

classes.content: For unfamiliar PDF structures, the agent may read original words with page references, run-local adapter code and partial entries needed for diagnosis. Code executes locally and independent checks remain mandatory. The incident service receives fixed technical categories, check results and counts, excluding documents, amounts, paths, adapter code and free-text rationales. A successful reread does not automatically close the original task. The full word inventory, adapter snapshots, bounded private adapter stderr, every trial, readable JSON/CSV entries and unresolved issues remain in the same local run. The host selects evidence for its existing model account; no automatic anonymization is claimed. The source-reference adapter runs in isolated Python with a time limit; this is not an OS security sandbox. Its path and code digest are sealed in the mapping recipe. Missing printed controls or failed coverage/accounting checks preserve entries as unqualified. Existing original-task recovery verification remains required. Bank recovery may expose selected statement words, dates, value dates, descriptions, references, amounts and printed opening/closing balances or movement totals to the host for layout review. It uses the same bounded inspection and run-local adapter route. Histories are separate by source side and bank source digest; source digests may appear in local inspection results read by the host, but are not sent in automatic incident reports. Bank reconstruction enforces source-reference coverage and bank arithmetic, then requires the ordinary mapping receipt and reconciliation gates.
classes.purpose: Diagnose unfamiliar journal and bank statement structures and review a local correction without weakening qualification

classes.content: Cowork and Antigravity use the calling host native Agent or invoke_subagent tool with a fresh child and the exact bounded packet. The parent reads that same request to dispatch it, so its mapped business fields enter both parent and child model contexts. Current host tool/type/model choices and the actual completed child ID, final response and zero observed tool uses are retained as parent-reported evidence. No provider API is called; the parent model is unchanged. This is not provider attestation or an OS isolation probe, and host ambient instructions are not excluded. Host-managed transcripts may persist. The local report records the parent-reported parent and child exposures separately and does not independently inspect the provider. Missing capabilities, incomplete children and children using tools cannot supply accepted allocations.
classes.purpose: Dispatch and validate bounded native semantic review in the current host

de: Zu Beginn liest das Modell eine begrenzte Anzahl von Zeilen, um die Felder zu erkennen und ihre Bedeutung zu verstehen. Zur Prüfung des PDF-Journallayouts kann es bis zu 300 Wörter aus jeder der ersten beiden und der letzten Seite erhalten, mit höchstens 100 Zeichen pro Wort, Koordinaten, Seitengrößen und Quellhash. Die vollständige Rekonstruktion erfolgt lokal. Zur Layout-Wiederherstellung kann jede vom Modell angeforderte Prüfung bis zu drei Seiten oder Bereiche mit höchstens 300 Wörtern und 1.200 Zeichen samt Koordinaten pro Seite sowie angeforderte Bilder zeigen. Das Modell liest auch vorgeschlagene Rezepte und Versuchsdiagnosen. Das Verfahren bewahrt den Verlauf in der Fallablage auf, erlaubt vier Versuche und zwölf Prüfungen und sendet diese Daten nicht an Entwickler.
Der Code verarbeitet den gesamten Umfang lokal
Sobald Felder und Umfang bestätigt sind, verarbeitet der Code alle zum Auftrag gehörenden Daten nach offengelegten, wiederholbaren Regeln.
Das Modell erhält einen Index der zu prüfenden Fälle

Der Index verwendet undurchsichtige Fallreferenzen und zeigt nur Falltyp, Status und Arten von Prüfsignalen. Er enthält keine Namen, Beschreibungen, Beträge, Daten, Quellreferenzen oder Quellkennungen und keine Pfade.
Das Modell fordert bei Bedarf den Kontext eines Falls an

Nur für ausgewählte Fälle werden die gemappten, befüllten und für die Prüfung nützlichen Felder übermittelt. Leere Felder, nicht gemappte Spalten, Pfade und technische Kennungen bleiben ausgeschlossen; exakte fachliche Kennungen werden nur übermittelt, wenn der Vergleich sie erfordert.
Das Modell prüft den zugelassenen Restbestand

In Codex, Cowork und Antigravity kann nach dem Abgleich ein separater Schritt alle noch nicht zugeordneten Bankbewegungen und ihre kompatiblen Buchhaltungskandidaten mit ausschließlich gemappten, befüllten Feldern erhalten, wenn der vollständige Bestand in ein begrenztes Paket passt. Der Restbestand wird nie in automatische Aufrufe aufgeteilt: Überschreitet er die Grenzen, bleibt er vollständig in der menschlichen Prüfung. Dieser Schritt kann weder deterministische Zuordnungen noch die Freigabebereitschaft ändern.

Professionelle Daten werden nicht automatisch anonymisiert oder pseudonymisiert. Der Kontext eines ausgewählten Falls kann echte Namen, Beschreibungen, Beträge, Daten und Referenzen enthalten, wenn die fachliche Prüfung sie benötigt.

Bei der PDF-Wiederherstellung speichert die lokale Prüfung der Schreibweise negativer Beträge alle Auffälligkeiten und zeigt dem Modell höchstens 50 Meldungen pro Antwort mit Seite, Zeile, Spalte und gedrucktem Betrag. Das Modell sieht auch die vorgeschlagene Schreibweise und Behandlung des Vorzeichens; diese erfordern eine fachliche Prüfung. Bei unbekannten PDF-Strukturen kann der Agent Originalwörter mit Seitenverweisen, lokalen Adaptercode und die für die Diagnose benötigten teilweise gelesenen Buchungen lesen. Der Code läuft lokal; unabhängige Prüfungen bleiben verpflichtend. Der Störungsdienst erhält feste technische Kategorien, Prüfergebnisse und Anzahlen, jedoch keine Dokumente, Beträge, Pfade, Adaptercodes oder frei formulierten Begründungen. Erfolgreiches erneutes Einlesen schließt den ursprünglichen Auftrag nicht automatisch ab.

Bei unbekannten PDF-Kontoauszügen kann das Modell die für die Layoutprüfung nötigen Wörter, Daten, Beschreibungen, Referenzen und gedruckten Salden oder Summen prüfen. Der lokale Adapter schlägt Quellenverweise vor; der Code prüft die vollständige Erfassung und die Bankberechnungen. Teilergebnisse bleiben mit ausdrücklichen Fehlerhinweisen lesbar, während die vollständige Abstimmung gesperrt bleibt. Jeder Kontoauszug behält einen vom Journal getrennten Wiederherstellungsverlauf.

Studio Archive grenzt jede Ausführung dieses Prozesses ab und erstellt automatisch einen Bericht über die von Vera gesendeten Daten. Vera erfasst die eigenen Sendungen; der Bericht untersucht weder den Chat noch andere Werkzeuge. Der Bericht bleibt auf dem Rechner, auch wenn alle Daten gesendet wurden. Fehlende Mengenangaben werden ausdrücklich als unbekannt ausgewiesen. Der Server erhält nur den Berichtshash und die Prüfverweise, gebunden an die Vera userID des Rechners, dieselbe Ausführung und Revision. Berichtsinhalte und Nachweise bleiben lokal.

In Cowork und Antigravity gelangt dasselbe begrenzte Datenpaket in den Hauptchat und einen nativen Unteragenten: Der Hauptchat liest es, um die Arbeit zu starten. Vera bewahrt den vom Hauptchat beobachteten Aufruf und das Ergebnis auf, ohne das Hauptmodell zu ändern oder eine Anbieter-API aufzurufen. Diese Nachweise bestätigen weder die Modellidentität beim Anbieter noch eine Dateisystem-Isolation und schließen vom Host ergänzte Anweisungen nicht aus. Unteragenten-Protokolle können im Host gespeichert bleiben. Fehlende Fähigkeiten oder unvollständige Ergebnisse lassen Posten ungeklärt.
en: At the start, the model reads a limited number of rows to identify the fields and understand what they mean. For PDF journal layout review it may receive up to 300 words from each of the first two and final pages, capped at 100 characters per word, with coordinates, page dimensions and the source hash. Full reconstruction runs locally. For layout recovery, each model-requested inspection can show up to three pages or regions, with at most 300 words and 1,200 characters with coordinates per page, plus requested images. The model also reads proposed recipes and trial diagnostics. The procedure retains history in the case workspace, allows four trials and twelve inspections, and does not send this data to developers.
The code processes the full scope locally
Once the fields and scope are confirmed, the code processes all data included in the work using declared, repeatable rules.
The model receives an index of cases to review
The index uses opaque case references and shows only the case type, status, and control signal types. It contains no names, descriptions, amounts, dates, source references or identifiers, or paths.
The model requests a case's context when needed

Only selected cases supply the mapped, populated fields useful to the review. Empty fields, unmapped columns, paths, and technical identifiers stay out; exact professional identifiers arrive only when the comparison requires them.
The model reviews the admitted residual

In Codex, Cowork and Antigravity, after reconciliation, a separate step may receive all still-unmatched bank movements and their compatible accounting candidates, using only mapped, populated fields, when the complete set fits one bounded packet. The residual is never split into automatic calls: if it exceeds the limits, it remains entirely in human review. This step cannot change deterministic matches or readiness.
Professional data is not automatically anonymized or pseudonymized. Selected case context may contain real names, descriptions, amounts, dates, and references when professional review requires them.

During PDF recovery, the local negative-amount notation check retains every issue and shows the model at most 50 issues per response, with page, row, column and printed amount. The model also sees the proposed notation and sign-treatment choices; these require professional review. For unfamiliar PDF structures, the agent may read original words with page references, run-local adapter code and partial entries needed for diagnosis. Code executes locally and independent checks remain mandatory. The incident service receives fixed technical categories, check results and counts, excluding documents, amounts, paths, adapter code and free-text rationales. A successful reread does not automatically close the original task.

For unfamiliar bank statement PDFs, the model may inspect source words, dates, descriptions, references and printed balances or totals needed to review the layout. The local adapter proposes source references; code checks coverage and bank arithmetic. Partial results remain readable with explicit issues while complete reconciliation stays blocked. Each statement keeps a recovery history separate from the journal.

Studio Archive delimits each run of this process and automatically creates a report of the data Vera sent. Vera records its own sends; the report does not inspect the chat or other tools. The report stays on the machine even when all data was sent. Missing counts are explicitly unknown. The server receives only the report hash and verification references, bound to the machine’s Vera userID, the same run and revision. Report contents and evidence remain local.

In Cowork and Antigravity, the same bounded packet enters both the main chat and a native child agent: the parent reads it to dispatch the work. Vera retains the invocation and result observed by the parent, without changing the main model or calling a provider API. This evidence does not attest provider model identity, prove filesystem isolation or exclude host-added instructions. Child transcripts may persist in the host. Missing capabilities or an incomplete result leave items unresolved.
es: Al principio, el modelo lee un número limitado de filas para reconocer los campos y comprender su significado. Para revisar el diseño del diario PDF puede recibir hasta 300 palabras de cada una de las dos primeras páginas y de la última, con un máximo de 100 caracteres por palabra, coordenadas, dimensiones y hash de la fuente. La reconstrucción completa se ejecuta localmente. Para recuperar el diseño, cada inspección solicitada por el modelo puede mostrar hasta tres páginas o regiones, con un máximo de 300 palabras y 1.200 caracteres con coordenadas por página, además de las imágenes solicitadas. El modelo también lee las recetas propuestas y los diagnósticos. El procedimiento conserva el historial en el expediente, permite cuatro intentos y doce inspecciones y no envía estos datos a los desarrolladores.
El código procesa localmente todo el alcance
Una vez confirmados los campos y el alcance, el código procesa todos los datos incluidos en el trabajo mediante reglas declaradas y repetibles.
El modelo recibe un índice de los casos que deben revisarse

El índice utiliza referencias opacas a los casos y muestra solo el tipo de caso, el estado y los tipos de señales del control. No contiene nombres, descripciones, importes, fechas, referencias o identificadores presentes en las fuentes ni rutas.
El modelo solicita el contexto de un caso cuando lo necesita

Solo los casos seleccionados aportan los campos mapeados y cumplimentados útiles para la revisión. Quedan fuera los campos vacíos, las columnas no mapeadas, las rutas y los identificadores técnicos; los identificadores profesionales exactos solo se incluyen cuando la comparación los exige.
El modelo revisa el residuo admitido

En Codex, Cowork y Antigravity, después de la conciliación, un paso separado puede recibir todos los movimientos bancarios aún sin conciliar y sus candidatos contables compatibles, usando únicamente campos mapeados y cumplimentados, si el conjunto completo cabe en un único paquete limitado. El residuo nunca se divide en llamadas automáticas: si supera los límites, permanece íntegramente en revisión humana. Este paso no puede modificar las conciliaciones deterministas ni el estado de preparación.

Los datos profesionales no se anonimizan ni se seudonimizan automáticamente. El contexto de un caso seleccionado puede contener nombres, descripciones, importes, fechas y referencias reales cuando la revisión profesional los necesita.

Durante la recuperación del PDF, la comprobación local de la notación de importes negativos conserva todas las anomalías y muestra al modelo como máximo 50 incidencias por respuesta, con página, fila, columna e importe impreso. El modelo también ve las opciones propuestas de notación y tratamiento del signo, que requieren revisión profesional. Ante estructuras PDF desconocidas, el agente puede leer palabras originales con referencias de página, código de un adaptador local y asientos parciales necesarios para el diagnóstico. El código se ejecuta localmente y los controles independientes siguen siendo obligatorios. El servicio de incidencias recibe categorías técnicas fijas, resultados de controles y recuentos, sin documentos, importes, rutas, código del adaptador ni explicaciones libres. Una nueva lectura correcta no cierra automáticamente el trabajo original.

Para extractos bancarios PDF no reconocidos, el modelo puede examinar las palabras, fechas, descripciones, referencias y saldos o totales impresos necesarios para revisar el diseño. El adaptador local propone referencias a la fuente; el código comprueba la cobertura y los cálculos bancarios. Los resultados parciales siguen siendo legibles con incidencias explícitas, mientras la conciliación completa permanece bloqueada. Cada extracto conserva un historial de recuperación separado del diario.

Studio Archive delimita cada ejecución de este proceso y crea automáticamente un informe de los datos enviados por Vera. Vera registra sus propios envíos; el informe no inspecciona el chat ni otras herramientas. El informe permanece en el equipo incluso cuando se han enviado todos los datos. Los recuentos que faltan se indican como indeterminados. El servidor recibe únicamente la huella del informe y las referencias de verificación, vinculadas al Vera userID del equipo, a la misma ejecución y revisión. El contenido del informe y las evidencias permanecen locales.

En Cowork y Antigravity, el mismo paquete delimitado entra en el contexto del chat principal y de un agente secundario nativo: el chat lo lee para iniciar el trabajo. Vera conserva la llamada y el resultado observados por el coordinador, sin cambiar el modelo principal ni llamar a una API del proveedor. Esta evidencia no certifica la identidad del modelo, no prueba el aislamiento del sistema de archivos ni excluye las instrucciones añadidas por el host. Las transcripciones pueden permanecer en el host. Si faltan capacidades o el resultado está incompleto, las partidas siguen sin resolver.
fr: Au début, le modèle lit un nombre limité de lignes pour reconnaître les champs et en comprendre la signification. Pour la revue du journal PDF, il peut recevoir jusqu’à 300 mots de chacune des deux premières pages et de la dernière, limités à 100 caractères par mot, avec coordonnées, dimensions et empreinte de la source. La reconstruction complète est locale. Pour récupérer la mise en page, chaque inspection demandée par le modèle peut montrer jusqu’à trois pages ou régions, avec au maximum 300 mots et 1 200 caractères avec coordonnées par page, ainsi que les images demandées. Le modèle lit aussi les recettes proposées et les diagnostics. La procédure conserve l’historique dans le dossier, autorise quatre essais et douze inspections et ne transmet pas ces données aux développeurs.
Le code traite localement l'ensemble du périmètre
Une fois les champs et le périmètre confirmés, le code traite toutes les données incluses dans le travail selon des règles déclarées et reproductibles.
Le modèle reçoit un index des cas à examiner

L'index utilise des références de cas opaques et indique uniquement le type de cas, son statut et les types de signaux du contrôle. Il ne contient ni noms, descriptions, montants, dates, références ou identifiants provenant des sources, ni chemins.
Le modèle demande le contexte d'un cas lorsque nécessaire

Seuls les cas sélectionnés transmettent les champs mappés et renseignés utiles à la revue. Les champs vides, colonnes non mappées, chemins et identifiants techniques restent exclus ; les identifiants professionnels exacts ne sont transmis que lorsque la comparaison l'exige.
Le modèle examine le résidu admis

Dans Codex, Cowork et Antigravity, après le rapprochement, une étape distincte peut recevoir tous les mouvements bancaires encore non rapprochés et leurs candidats comptables compatibles, avec les seuls champs mappés et renseignés, si l’ensemble complet tient dans un paquet limité. Le résidu n’est jamais divisé en appels automatiques : s’il dépasse les limites, il reste intégralement soumis à la revue humaine. Cette étape ne peut modifier ni les rapprochements déterministes ni l’état de préparation.

Les données professionnelles ne sont pas automatiquement anonymisées ou pseudonymisées. Le contexte d'un cas sélectionné peut contenir des noms, descriptions, montants, dates et références réels lorsque la revue professionnelle l'exige.

Lors de la récupération du PDF, le contrôle local de la notation des montants négatifs conserve toutes les anomalies et montre au modèle au plus 50 signalements par réponse, avec page, ligne, colonne et montant imprimé. Le modèle voit aussi les choix proposés de notation et de traitement du signe, qui nécessitent une revue professionnelle. Pour une structure PDF inconnue, l’agent peut lire les mots originaux avec leurs références de page, le code d’un adaptateur local et les écritures partielles nécessaires au diagnostic. Le code s’exécute localement et les contrôles indépendants restent obligatoires. Le service d’incidents reçoit des catégories techniques fixes, les résultats des contrôles et des comptages, sans documents, montants, chemins, code de l’adaptateur ni explications libres. Une relecture réussie ne clôture pas automatiquement le travail initial.

Pour les relevés bancaires PDF non reconnus, le modèle peut examiner les mots, dates, descriptions, références et soldes ou totaux imprimés nécessaires à la revue de la mise en page. L’adaptateur local propose des références à la source ; le code vérifie la couverture et les calculs bancaires. Les résultats partiels restent lisibles avec leurs anomalies explicites, tandis que le rapprochement complet reste bloqué. Chaque relevé conserve un historique de récupération distinct du journal.

Studio Archive délimite chaque exécution de ce processus et crée automatiquement un rapport des données envoyées par Vera. Vera enregistre ses propres envois ; le rapport n’inspecte ni la conversation ni les autres outils. Le rapport reste sur la machine même lorsque toutes les données ont été envoyées. Les comptages manquants sont signalés comme indéterminés. Le serveur reçoit uniquement l’empreinte du rapport et les références de vérification, liées au Vera userID de la machine, à la même exécution et à la révision. Le contenu du rapport et les preuves restent locaux.

Dans Cowork et Antigravity, le même paquet limité entre dans le contexte de la conversation principale et d’un sous-agent natif : le parent le lit pour lancer le travail. Vera conserve l’appel et le résultat observés par le parent, sans changer le modèle principal ni appeler une API du fournisseur. Ces éléments ne certifient pas le modèle du fournisseur, ne prouvent pas l’isolation du système de fichiers et n’excluent pas les instructions ajoutées par l’hôte. Les transcriptions peuvent persister dans l’hôte. Les capacités manquantes ou un résultat incomplet laissent les postes non résolus.
it: All'inizio, il modello legge un numero limitato di righe per riconoscere i campi e comprenderne il significato. Per il layout del giornale PDF può ricevere fino a 300 parole da ciascuna delle prime due pagine e dell’ultima, con massimo 100 caratteri per parola, coordinate, dimensioni delle pagine e hash della fonte. La ricostruzione completa avviene localmente. Nel recupero del layout, ogni ispezione richiesta dal modello può mostrare fino a tre pagine o regioni, con al massimo 300 parole e 1.200 caratteri con coordinate per pagina, oltre alle immagini richieste. Il modello legge anche ricette proposte e diagnostica dei tentativi. La procedura conserva la cronologia nel fascicolo, consente quattro tentativi e dodici ispezioni, e non invia questi dati agli sviluppatori.
Il codice elabora localmente l'intero perimetro
Una volta confermati i campi e il perimetro, il codice elabora tutti i dati compresi nel lavoro secondo regole dichiarate e ripetibili.
Il modello riceve un indice dei casi da rivedere

L'indice usa riferimenti opachi ai casi e mostra solo il tipo di caso, lo stato e i tipi di segnale del controllo. Non contiene nomi, descrizioni, importi, date, riferimenti o identificativi presenti nelle fonti, né percorsi.
Il modello richiede il contesto di un caso quando serve

Solo per i casi selezionati arrivano i campi mappati e valorizzati utili alla revisione. Campi vuoti, colonne non mappate, percorsi e identificativi tecnici restano fuori; gli identificativi professionali esatti arrivano solo quando sono necessari al confronto.
Il modello esamina il residuo ammesso

Nei runtime Codex, Cowork e Antigravity, dopo la riconciliazione, un passaggio separato può ricevere tutti i movimenti bancari ancora aperti e i candidati contabili compatibili, con i soli campi mappati e valorizzati, se l’intero insieme rientra in un unico pacchetto limitato. Il residuo non viene diviso in chiamate automatiche: se supera i limiti, resta interamente alla revisione umana. Questo passaggio non può modificare gli abbinamenti deterministici né lo stato di prontezza.

I dati professionali non vengono anonimizzati né pseudonimizzati automaticamente. Il contesto di un caso selezionato può contenere nomi, descrizioni, importi, date e riferimenti reali quando servono alla revisione professionale.

Nel recupero del PDF, la verifica locale della notazione degli importi negativi conserva tutte le anomalie e mostra al modello al massimo 50 segnalazioni per risposta, con pagina, riga, colonna e importo stampato. Il modello vede anche le scelte proposte per notazione e trattamento del segno; queste richiedono la revisione del professionista. Per strutture PDF non riconosciute, l’agente può leggere le parole originali con i riferimenti di pagina, il codice di un adattatore locale e le scritture parziali necessarie alla diagnosi. Il codice viene eseguito localmente e i controlli indipendenti restano obbligatori. Al servizio incidenti arrivano categorie tecniche fisse, esiti dei controlli e conteggi; non documenti, importi, percorsi, codice dell’adattatore o motivazioni libere. Una rilettura riuscita non chiude automaticamente il lavoro originale.

Per gli estratti conto PDF non riconosciuti, il modello può esaminare parole, date, descrizioni, riferimenti e saldi o totali stampati necessari a rivedere il layout. L’adattatore locale propone riferimenti alla fonte; il codice verifica copertura e aritmetica bancaria. I risultati parziali restano leggibili con le anomalie esplicite, mentre la riconciliazione completa rimane bloccata. Ogni estratto conto conserva una cronologia di recupero separata dal giornale.

Studio Archive delimita ogni esecuzione di questo processo e crea automaticamente un report dei dati inviati da Vera. Vera registra i propri invii; il report non ispeziona la chat o altri strumenti. Il report viene conservato sulla macchina anche quando tutti i dati sono stati inviati. I conteggi mancanti sono indicati come non determinabili. Il server riceve soltanto l’impronta del report e i riferimenti di verifica, associati al Vera userID della macchina, alla stessa esecuzione e alla revisione. Il contenuto del report e le evidenze restano locali.

In Cowork e Antigravity, lo stesso pacchetto delimitato entra nel contesto della chat principale e di un agente secondario nativo: la chat lo legge per avviare il lavoro. Vera conserva la chiamata e il risultato osservati dal coordinatore, senza cambiare il modello principale né chiamare API del fornitore. La verifica non certifica il modello del fornitore, non prova un isolamento del filesystem e non esclude le istruzioni aggiunte dall’host. Le trascrizioni degli agenti possono restare nell’host. Se mancano le capacità richieste o il risultato completo, le partite restano irrisolte.

security_controls.control: For active Archive runs, tabular inspection registers its bounded preview coordinates and reconciliation registers the normalizer's transaction-field origins. Selected MCP case responses carry app-only field-origin requests and the digest of the producer's private review packet; the collector accepts them only against retained producer evidence. The worker launcher registers the exact prompt and output schema against the selected candidate records before submission. Preparation alone does not count as disclosure. Exact operational messages and metadata-only recipe revisions retain their own declarations. Producer-created resolution documents bind their exact bytes to copied source fields or amount/currency/unit aggregates. The residual CSV declares each output cell's source fields, including both amounts used by an allocation; a recorded partial read adds only the selected cells' origins. Identical table bytes at different producer paths do not exchange origins. Unknown review packets, changed artifacts, unsupported provenance and partial reads without a cell declaration remain explicitly incomplete rather than acquiring an inferred unsent remainder. The original source files, local outgoing payloads and field coordinates are not included in server receipt requests.

The shared structured-worker entrypoint checks the caller-supplied output directory for a symlink before resolving the path and before opening authentication boundary inputs or launching a process. Its regression supplies a symlink to another empty directory and verifies rejection without credential access or output writes. This check covers the supplied leaf; it does not claim atomic protection from all concurrent ancestor-path changes.

Inspection, receipt sealing, and reconciliation require a digest-valid running Studio Archive context. Sealing resolves source receipts only to exact bound inputs, verifies current bytes, requires explicit reviewer identity/date and complete decisions, and replays source qualification before replacing the run-local recipe. No external script or MCP registration is needed.

Bank and journal sources emit movements only through bounded tabular adapters and source-bound reviewed mapping receipts. The PDF-table-v1 adapter accepts only text PDFs with a labelled physical column grid, an explicit date header and monetary header, and an exact repeated page-table header; it preserves page, table and row lineage, while generic text, inconsistent tables, OCR-only sources and transaction-like candidate pages outside the recovered table emit zero rows. PDF mappings never qualify automatically and must bind the recovered header, amount/debit/credit roles, numeric convention, the complete current potential-monetary-column list, and explicit exclusions such as running balance. The default tabular-v6 contract remains unchanged; additive tabular-v7 is selected only by a current receipt that explicitly binds Italian textual-month date_locale or exact reviewed non-movement summary labels. The v7 parser accepts only the frozen full Italian month vocabulary and valid Gregorian dates, while summary exclusion requires an exact reviewed label, a blank mapped date, and no stable explicit reference. CSV profiling covers only comma, semicolon, tab, and pipe within fixed byte and row limits; profiling is transport evidence rather than semantic authority, non-default or conflicting delimiters require a current receipt, and ambiguous, unsupported, malformed, ragged, stale, or partly invalid sources emit zero rows. Reviewed mappings bind the field delimiter separately from numeric separators and bind the complete current potential-monetary-column list plus explicit exclusions. Non-canonical direction labels require a complete source-specific mapping to positive, negative, or zero that agrees with the exact signed amount, and the relationship policy is a separate reviewed-decision receipt bound to the current bank and journal artifact digests, currency, unit, entity, party, direction, tolerance, and date-window perimeter.

Relationship-v3 matching uses exact-decimal amounts, actual dates where required, distinctive explicit references, stable prepared identities, conflict-free batch snapshots, and non-reusing balanced relationship ledgers. Reviewed one-to-many or many-to-one groups require a shared stable reference and conserved group totals; overlapping groups remain unmatched. Row order cannot award contested evidence, while unmatched, reused, cross-currency, or residual rows keep readiness blocked.

The currently implemented Codex isolated adapter for residual resolution validates the current deterministic receipts and material-value replay before admitting the complete eligible residual to one size-capped candidate packet for a runtime-verified deny-default Codex worker (a low-cost model and reasoning effort discovered from the current host model catalog, or an explicit retained selection). It never automatically chunks an over-cap residual: no worker launches and every movement remains in the human-review queue. The packet is projected after mapping and omits unmapped raw columns, empty canonical fields, physical source locators, and the derived absolute amount. Raw output is non-authoritative until strict schema, graph, lifecycle, launch-receipt, evidence non-reuse, and evidence checks pass. Accepted decisions update only sibling certainty-funnel, human-review-queue, and operational-review-payload artifacts under the recorded threshold; Luna cannot assign perfect_match or mutate canonical matches, ledgers, receipts, assurance gates, or report readiness. Draft preparation defaults to perfect_match without attributing a decision to the user. The worker still analyses the admitted residuals, but its judgments cannot reach that deterministic-only level, so they remain in the review queue. An explicitly established lower clearance policy remains supported; no professional adoption or signature is implied.

MCP validation can load the sibling review JSON inside the local server and returns only a non-identifying index plus a random four-hour reference. Rendering exposes the complete validated payload only in tool-result _meta, which is component-only, while model-visible content and structuredContent contain the index. The widget hydrates from toolResponseMetadata and retains the complete human review surface. The local widget displays the existing native bank and journal dates and amounts, shared references and deltas with localized labels. Read-only reopening resolves and validates the owning portable run, including nested result folders. Archived results show a read-only notice and disabled save/apply buttons; server write authority still requires a running run. This adds no model payload or external route.

The read-only case-context tool accepts only opaque handles bound to the current in-memory review reference, rejects unknown or duplicate handles, limits each call to 25 cases and 500000 response bytes, projects explicit post-mapping field allowlists, and keeps exact professional identifiers off unless explicitly requested for those selected cases.

MCP save and apply capture the complete regular single-link output tree, bytes, and root/directory/file modes in bounded parent-process memory before child execution; linked, aliased, special, over-count, over-file-size, and over-total-size trees fail before mutation, and rejected operations restore only from the trusted image with fixed path-free errors and no transaction residue.

The MCP parent reconstructs and replays the persisted assurance baseline, validates the child file/mode delta against an explicit write set, derives every effect, count, path, gate transition, readiness status, limitation, next action, reviewed application decision, receipt bundle, and final reviewed envelope from trusted request and run state, and treats child stdout only as a bounded acknowledgement.

A regenerated Journal–Bank XLSX must remain a bounded well-formed OOXML package with deterministic core and ZIP timestamps and member order, the exact entry and presentation contract, no duplicate, hidden, extra, traversal, formula, namespace, CRC, or XML content. Every visible worksheet must close cell-for-cell to the canonical CSV schedules, and every declared match or relationship-residual material value is replayed sequentially across the complete prepared, CSV, and read-only XLSX populations without random worksheet access.

After the audit, review handoff, receipt bundle, and assurance envelope are written, a bounded fixed-point pass refreshes the final artifact manifest and execution trace, requires every listed output path and byte count to match the current files, and validates the current final-artifacts receipt without creating a recursive receipt for the receipt bundle itself.

Child startup, nonzero exit, oversized, empty, malformed, forged status-zero, preflight divergence, workbook tamper, and rollback failure paths return fixed bounded messages; helper stdout, tracebacks, absolute client paths, recovery paths, and unvalidated child fields are not copied into responses or execution traces.

A source-qualification or relationship-authority block emits no matches or material-value ledger, but still closes the exact reviewable initial package with normalized and unmatched partitions, empty match and residual schedules, a blocked relationship ledger, workbook, per-side source outcomes, audit, review payload, handoff, receipts, assurance envelope and final artifact manifest.

An alternative worker model requires a reviewed-decision receipt bound to the workflow, model, effort and benchmark digest. CLI selection files are authorized engagement inputs. This checks a local review declaration, not reviewer authentication or benchmark quality; it never changes native host qualification or read boundaries. The default remains Luna. Configuration and review identity remain bound during replay and recovery.

Python entrypoints redirect bytecode lookup and disable bytecode writes before validating and loading the declared source implementation. Cache directories and regular bytecode files are excluded from the source receipt set; they are not treated as executable authority. Optional explicit repair removes only ordinary single-link .pyc files directly inside cache folders under this component own vendor tree, without traversing symlinks or falling back to shared vendor roots. This local maintenance path does not add model calls or external destinations.

The local review server requires the session token for output downloads. It accepts only files declared by the local run, within its output directory, rejects symlinks and traversal, and limits downloads to 50 MB. Files are downloaded as opaque bytes; HTML is not executed in the review origin. This does not claim atomic protection from concurrent filesystem changes. The browser may retain a user-requested downloaded copy; this route does not send document content to the model or an external service.

The v5 shared worker verifies live allow/deny filesystem canaries and required Codex exec capabilities inside the unchanged deny-default Seatbelt boundary. Actual OS build, Codex version and external executable digests are recorded per run without fixed release allowlists. Executables and runtime inputs are rechecked before output publication; concurrent changes reject the result. Historical v1–v4 records remain unchanged for receipt verification and cannot launch new work. No packet fields or external destination are added. Model/effort remain requested, not independently observed; JSONL does not prove hidden-tool absence.

The mapping receipt binds reviewed physical bands and header/footer exclusions to the source digest. Overlapping bands, unmapped money, missing-text body pages, incomplete registrations or unequal registration debit/credit totals withhold the complete source. Page caches are released after each page. No PDF posting is qualified by text readability alone.

The Windows process capture helper uses bounded pipe readers and a kill-on-close Job Object. A fixed gate waits for successful job assignment before launching the requested command. This is local process lifecycle control, not filesystem isolation qualification: the semantic worker remains unavailable outside its explicitly qualified host profiles; no sandbox or payload restriction is relaxed.

The reviewed bank layout binds source bytes, currency, physical columns, printed controls and the exact run-local adapter. Independent reconstruction rejects fabricated, duplicated or unclaimed monetary tokens, mismatched balances and totals, and changed mapping/adapter bindings. Failed checks retain readable entries as unqualified. Per-source bank histories and incident episodes are separate from journal recovery; extraction replay cannot certify the original task.

The shared owned configuration provides cost candidates; the running Codex app-server model/list provides actual model and reasoning capabilities without creating a conversation. The receipt retains catalog and policy hashes and observed runtime. Availability does not establish model quality. Cowork and Antigravity packages select their own host and explicitly retain unresolved residuals because a verified isolated invocation adapter is not implemented; they never silently launch Codex.
